correctness.rationale: The proof separates domination from the restraint condition using part support. For proper sets, restraint is equivalent to complement support at least two; domination is equivalent to support at least two or selection of an entire single part. The polynomial follows by exact counting, and bounded exhaustive verification independently tests the original definition.
